comment: Register semantics for the fuxi display probe. The SM8550 display block is the one sheng pins, so the same reviewed sources apply; this file states which revisions the offsets in facts/display_engine_facts.json were checked against.

device_tree.note: The offsets are the driver own block offsets from qcom,sde-*-off, not physical addresses; the physical windows come from the same tree reg properties.

runtime.source: adb from the running HyperOS system, 2026-11-14, with the panel live
runtime.why: The tree says what the panel can do; the running driver says what it chose, which is what the port has to reproduce.

limitations: The probe is read-only and has not run on the device yet, so no fuxi register value is confirmed against a target-side read.

The XNU display contract (NativeLegacyDisplay binding to the original MobileFramebuffer) needs the prelinked candidates of the target OS build, which this port does not have; the present code stops before that boundary.
No refresh rate, frame deadline or VBL follows from sampling registers; those come from the panel timings and from what the compositor asks for.
